Support the Ministry The porch is always free

You’re already welcome here—no payment required to stay, learn, or return.

This is a Bible-teaching ministry. The daily porch—verse, search, plans, prayer wall, kids tools—is free forever, no ads, no tracking. Paid support levels fund teaching content, free outreach packs to prisons and hospitals, and deeper tools for people who preach, teach, or lead. Every dollar goes directly to the mission. See exactly where support goes.

Free includes daily verse, search, Möbius, plans, prayer wall, kids corner, and offline-friendly saves. Support levels add sync, email, builders, team features, and fund the ministry’s outreach work.

Later, if it fits the mission

We may add a deeper “companion” tier when there is clear demand and real features to ship—for example fuller audio across plans, a verse-card studio with your own imagery, gentle family offline packs, or private prayer-chain tools that stay anonymous-by-design. Nothing here is for sale yet; the plans above are what you can subscribe to today.

When support becomes practical

Free is enough to build a real daily practice. Support makes sense when you want the deeper tools—and when you want what you give to do more than unlock features.

  • Tired of re-typing prayers on a new phone? Sync with Supporter—your prayer list, notes, and progress follow you.
  • Want today’s verse in your inbox? Supporter sends the Daily Battle at a time you choose.
  • Building sermons or lessons? Export to PDF, save drafts, share links—included in Supporter.
  • Want your giving to reach people in prisons or hospitals? Battle Pro and Church support fund free outreach packs directly.

Why support this ministry?

Your support keeps search, verse, and plans free for everyone—including the person who found this site at midnight in a hospital room and has nothing to give. It also funds teaching content, new Battle Plans, free printable packs, and the builder’s ability to keep showing up. By subscribing you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Prefer one-time giving? Open the gift page—any amount helps and nothing is wasted.
